units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24b:17">Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ברוב הֲדָרֵךְ</he> in the abundance of thy glory.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:8">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 110:3">Ps. CX, 3</cite>) <he>מֵהֲדָרוֹ של עולם וכ׳</he> from the glory of the world (the East) have I consecrated thee; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 869:4">Yalk. Ps. 869</cite> <he>בהררי קדש בהררי של עולם וכ׳</he> ‘in the mountains of holiness’, among the mountains, i.e. the distinguished, of the world &c.).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:4:2">Y. Succ. III, 53ᵈ</cite> a tree <he>שפריו ה׳ וכ׳</he> whose fruit is beautiful &c.—
Lev. R. s. 30; a. fr.—[Ib. תרגם עקילס הגר הדר Aquila in his translation read our w. haddar, v. דּוּר I.]

senses.gloss: עֵץ הָדָר (b. h.) the tree Hadar. Ib.; a. fr.
